listings.title: Clipboard Bridge
listings.shortDescription: Copy text and images. Send photos, videos and files between Android and Windows.
listings.fullDescription:
Copy here. Paste there. Send the rest as files.

Clipboard Bridge connects your Android phone and Windows PC without an app account, Firebase project, service-account key or maintainer relay. Pair your devices on the same local network, compare the codes and approve the connection.

CLIPBOARD FOR QUICK COPIES
Copy text or one image on Windows for automatic sending, or send manually from the tray. On Android, send clipboard text or one image from the foreground app. The dedicated image-to-clipboard picker accepts exactly one image. Share one image from another app through Clipboard Bridge to the computer clipboard; shared plain text asks for a Send tap.

FILES FOR EVERYTHING ELSE
Send multiple photos, videos, documents and other attachments through Android Share or the system file picker. Send files saves even a single selected image as a file. From Windows, use the tray file picker or Share panel to send files to Android storage. Received files keep their original bytes, are never opened automatically and do not replace the clipboard. Folders are not supported.

SEE PROGRESS. CHOOSE YOUR FOLDER.
Both endpoints show transfer progress. Success waits for the receiver to save the files and return a confirmation. Windows saves to Downloads or a folder you choose in Settings. Android 10 and later saves to Downloads/Clipboard Bridge by default; a receiving folder can also be selected. Android 8 and 9 require selecting a receiving folder. No broad all-files permission is needed.

PAUSE WHEN YOU WANT
Pause new sending and receiving on Android without losing pairing. Windows tray pause stops automatic clipboard sending; deliberate file sending remains available when the phone is enabled. Both apps follow the system language, with nine supported locales and English fallback.

REQUIREMENTS AND LIMITS
The matching Windows companion is required. The app links to the public GitHub Releases page so you can download it on your PC. New file-transfer features require both endpoints to support version 0.2.0.

Google Play services and access to Google FCM are required. Regions or networks without access to Google are currently unsupported. No idle Android foreground service is needed: Google Play services handles wake-ups. Active file transfers use temporary foreground work and progress notifications, which stop afterward. Windows must be running and reachable directly for file transfers and larger clipboard content.

Clipboard content is limited to text or one image up to 16 MiB; clipboard images travel as PNG. File batches allow up to 1,000 files without that clipboard size limit, subject to storage, connection duration and Android background limits. File batches expire after one hour.

Clipboard and file transfers use authenticated encryption between approved devices. Google can still process push routing metadata. There are no ads or analytics. Free and open source; this is a preview release.

Source, Windows downloads and support: https://github.com/c01-in/clipboard-bridge
Privacy: https://github.com/c01-in/clipboard-bridge/blob/main/PRIVACY.md
